data.label: Viewer-relative observation
data.description: The actual model input: 13,708 encoded observation values for the acting seat. Board planes, public context, cargo descriptors and legal-action lookup features are derived from this same observation.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Board feature planes: 45 × 49 × 1,390
data.description: HexPlanes scatters viewer-relative hex, edge, intersection, ship and mission features onto a fixed rectangular canvas. The 1,390 channels mix categorical indicators, quantities, posterior probabilities and geometry; they are not all one-hot image colors.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Global context: 578 features
data.description: HexContext gathers seat-relative public counters, mission progress, pieces, hands/posteriors, resource covariance and fixed global features. Each encoder learns its own 578→128 context MLP.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Legal action IDs: variable L
data.description: The second actual model input is a list of L ordered legal action IDs. 512 is the compiled serving padding floor, not the action-space size or a fixed number of choices. Padding uses ID −1. The complete action vocabulary contains 82,819 IDs.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Entity table: local position + attributes
data.description: Gather fixed hex, edge and intersection positions; add projected ship attributes; construct village, lair and shoal descriptors plus a null entity. This local path retains explicit entity locations and bypasses global mean/max pooling.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Entity table: local position + attributes
data.description: Gather fixed hex, edge and intersection positions; add projected ship attributes; construct village, lair and shoal descriptors plus a null entity. This returned table is discarded by the independent value head. Its 5,664 adapter parameters have no gradient path to current PPG losses.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Payload embedding: 1,967×32
data.description: Learn a 32-dimensional embedding for each canonical action payload. A fixed lookup maps each legal action ID to its payload ID.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Action-family embedding: 49×16
data.description: Learn a 16-dimensional descriptor for each action family.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Per-legal-action features: 264
data.description: For each legal action concatenate: first entity 32, second entity 32, their elementwise product 32, payload embedding 32, action-family embedding 16 and two selected cargo descriptions totaling 120.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Action MLP: 264→128 + SiLU
data.description: Learn how the referenced entities, cargo and action metadata interact. Configured dropout is disabled.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Action representation: 128→64
data.description: Produce a 64-dimensional representation for each legal action.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Global policy query: 256→64
data.description: Transform the actor global MLP output into a query that scores action representations.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Global family logits: 256→49
data.description: Predict preferences among 49 action families from the actor global representation.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Dot product + legal mask
data.description: For each legal action sum the 64 products between its representation and the global query. Padded IDs receive −∞. This does not allocate an 82,819-wide dense classifier.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Policy distribution over the L legal moves
data.description: Subtract the within-family log-sum-exp from each action score, add that family’s global logit, then softmax over the supplied legal actions. Collection samples this move distribution; normal raw evaluation chooses its maximum.
data.family_normalization: Only families represented in the legal list contribute probability.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Critic features: LayerNorm + saved scaling
data.description: Apply functional LayerNorm to the 256 hidden values, subtract the saved center and divide by the saved scale. These normalization buffers are not trainable. Configured critic dropout 0.5 is disabled in current PPG.
data.usage: Auxiliary phase: teach outcome features to actor with a post-policy KL anchor. Frozen/not a policy-phase critic-gradient path.
data.provenance: Retained supplied Catan interface/head architecture; no checkpoint weights.

data.label: Public value context: 18

metadata.description: Untrained Catan ConvNeXt Small proposal. Verified encoder implementation; original supplied action/outcome architecture retained as a descriptive integration contract.

proposal.validation_scope: CNN encoder only. Full original Catan game forward and PPG trainer require application integration.

important_details: The 1,390 board planes, 578 context features, original entity coordinates, 82,819 action IDs, 49 action families and variable legal list L are preserved.
Separate actor and value encoders each use channels 32→48→64 and 1/1/3 ConvNeXt residual blocks, with 2× channel expansion and no dilation gaps.
Padding is retained. Two stride-2 transitions produce 45×49→23×25→12×13; the final nominal receptive field is 97×97 original cells.
The 45×49 stage-1 map bypasses downsampling. Its 32 channels concatenate with 64 upsampled coarse channels before the original 96→32 entity projection.
The hidden output stays 256-wide, the entity table stays 526×32, and the action head scores only the supplied legal moves.
Original PPG head structure and phase-specific gradient isolation remain the integration contract: independent critic training, actor auxiliary outcome head, and post-policy KL anchor.
Every encoder weight is new. No pretrained checkpoint, old channel-specific stem refinement offsets, training statistics or optimizer state is attached.
The value encoder's unused entity/ship adapters remain stored to preserve the original module interface; their 5,664 parameters are included.
Spatial MAC counts exclude norms, activations, interpolation, entity projection, and heads. They are arithmetic estimates, not measured speedups.
metadata.format_notes: This is a descriptive full-model proposal with an executable standalone CNN encoder. Original custom featurization, entity assembly, legal-policy normalization and PPG trainer are preserved as interface specifications; they are not silently replaced by generic builder operations.
